The most apt description for Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s mass admonition of corporate India at the FICCI AGM is that it was a cri de coeur. One big cause of Modi’s frustration with corporate India is its unwillingness to pass on the benefits of tax cuts through raises, hiring, or investment. India Inc doesn’t dare speak up to Modi. But they whisper dark things on the sidelines. Watch this week’s with Shekhar Gupta.
